Syphon brewing

This page covers syphon: fresh beans, a steady grind and clean water matter most.

Weigh the coffee and the water so every brew can be repeated.

Taste, change one variable, and taste again before changing anything else.

Syphon FAQ

Is a syphon hard to use?

It takes a few tries to control the heat.

What grind suits a syphon?

Medium, like table salt.

How long does a syphon brew take?

About ninety seconds of contact time.

Example Coffee Lab, brewing notes since 2019.
